description: Search DEV.to articles by keyword. Uses the public Forem API first for relevance sorting, and falls back to the DEV.to search page when the API fails or when newest/oldest sorting is requested. Returns article cards with title, description, tags, author, comment/reaction counts, and publish date.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Search keyword, e.g. a programming language, framework, or topic.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Result order: relevance (default, API-first) | newest | oldest. newest/oldest use the browser page because the public API does not support sorting.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of articles to return (1-1000, default 20).
